# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Per-side fixture wrapper: run PROGRAM with a hung-up pty slave as stdout
# ("out"), or with a pty master as stdin whose slave already wrote DATAFILE
# and closed ("in"). Kernel behaviour only; no injection.
import errno, os, sys, tty
mode = sys.argv[1]
rest = sys.argv[2:]
master, slave = os.openpty()
if mode == "out":
    os.close(master)
    try:
        os.write(slave, b"x")
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno != errno.EIO:
            sys.exit(98)
    else:
        sys.exit(99)
    os.dup2(slave, 1)
    os.close(slave)
elif mode == "in":
    data = open(rest[0], "rb").read()
    rest = rest[1:]
    tty.setraw(slave)
    view = memoryview(data)
    while view:
        view = view[os.write(slave, view):]
    os.close(slave)
    os.dup2(master, 0)
    os.close(master)
else:
    sys.exit(97)
assert rest[0] == "--"
os.execv(rest[1], rest[1:])
files.fault-control.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted fault-mechanism controls for setup_script. Independent of every
# builtin under test: each mode proves one kernel or filter behaviour with
# direct system calls and exits 1 (failing setup, so the case is ERROR) when
# the behaviour is absent. pty modes report on fd 3; others on stdout.
import ctypes, errno, os, resource, sys
mode, args = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
out = os.fdopen(3, "w") if mode.startswith("pty-") else sys.stdout
NAME = errno.errorcode


def say(text):
    out.write(mode + ": " + text + "\n")
    out.flush()


def die(text):
    say("CONTROL FAILED: " + text)
    sys.exit(1)


def expect(label, code, fn):
    try:
        got = fn()
    except OSError as exc:
        if exc.errno != code:
            die("%s gave %s, expected %s" % (label, NAME.get(exc.errno, exc.errno), NAME[code]))
        say("%s -> %s" % (label, NAME[code]))
        return
    die("%s returned %r, expected %s" % (label, got, NAME[code]))


def scratch(directory):
    path = os.path.join(directory, ".control.%d" % os.getpid())
    return path, os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)


if mode == "devfull":
    fd = os.open("/dev/full", os.O_WRONLY)
    expect("write(/dev/full)", errno.ENOSPC, lambda: os.write(fd, b"x"))
elif mode == "fsize":
    lim = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE)[0]
    if lim == resource.RLIM_INFINITY or lim < 2:
        die("RLIMIT_FSIZE not limited: %r" % lim)
    path, fd = scratch(args[0])
    n = os.write(fd, b"a" * (lim + 100))
    if n != lim:
        die("first write returned %d, expected short write of %d" % (n, lim))
    say("write(%d bytes) at offset 0 -> short %d (limit %d)" % (lim + 100, n, lim))
    expect("write at the limit", errno.EFBIG, lambda: os.write(fd, b"a"))
    os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
    os.lseek(fd, 0, os.SEEK_SET)
    os.write(fd, b"a" * (lim - 1))
    n = os.write(fd, b"41\n")
    if n != 1:
        die("3-byte write one byte below the limit returned %d, expected 1" % n)
    say("3-byte write one byte below the limit -> short 1")
    expect("next write", errno.EFBIG, lambda: os.write(fd, b"\n"))
    os.close(fd)
    os.unlink(path)
elif mode == "full":
    st = os.statvfs(args[0])
    say("statvfs %s: f_bavail=%d f_bsize=%d" % (args[0], st.f_bavail, st.f_bsize))
    path, fd = scratch(args[0])
    expect("1-byte write on full tmpfs", errno.ENOSPC, lambda: os.write(fd, b"x"))
    expect("4096-byte write on full tmpfs", errno.ENOSPC, lambda: os.write(fd, b"x" * 4096))
    os.close(fd)
    os.unlink(path)
elif mode == "pty-out":
    expect("write(stdout = hung-up pty slave)", errno.EIO, lambda: os.write(1, b"x"))
elif mode == "pty-in":
    want, total = int(args[0]), 0
    while True:
        try:
            data = os.read(0, 4096)
        except OSError as exc:
            if exc.errno != errno.EIO:
                die("read gave %s after %d bytes, expected EIO" % (NAME.get(exc.errno), total))
            break
        if not data:
            die("read returned EOF after %d bytes, expected EIO" % total)
        total += len(data)
    if total != want:
        die("read %d bytes before EIO, expected %d" % (total, want))
    say("read(stdin = pty master) -> %d bytes, then EIO" % total)
elif mode == "status-bit":
    bit = int(args[1])
    for line in open(args[0]):
        if line.startswith("SigIgn:"):
            if not (int(line.split()[1], 16) >> (bit - 1)) & 1:
                die("signal %d not ignored in an inheriting child" % bit)
            say("signal %d ignored in an inheriting child" % bit)
            break
    else:
        die("no SigIgn line")
elif mode == "epipe":
    r, w = os.pipe()
    os.close(r)
    expect("write to a pipe without readers", errno.EPIPE, lambda: os.write(w, b"x"))
elif mode == "fdatasync":
    path, fd = scratch(args[0])
    os.write(fd, b"data")
    expect("fdatasync(fd %d)" % fd, errno.EIO, lambda: os.fdatasync(fd))
    os.close(fd)
    os.unlink(path)
elif mode == "rename":
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    a = os.path.join(args[0], ".control-a").encode()
    b = os.path.join(args[0], ".control-b").encode()
    open(a, "wb").close()
    AT_FDCWD = -100
    calls = (("rename", lambda: libc.rename(a, b)),
             ("renameat", lambda: libc.renameat(AT_FDCWD, a, AT_FDCWD, b)),
             ("renameat2", lambda: libc.syscall(316, AT_FDCWD, a, AT_FDCWD, b, 0)))
    for label, call in calls:
        ctypes.set_errno(0)
        rc = call()
        if rc != -1 or ctypes.get_errno() != errno.EIO:
            die("%s returned %d errno %s, expected -1 EIO" % (label, rc, NAME.get(ctypes.get_errno())))
        if not os.path.exists(a) or os.path.exists(b):
            die("%s moved the file despite EIO" % label)
        say("%s -> EIO, source kept" % label)
    os.unlink(a)
elif mode == "close":
    target = int(args[0])
    path, fd = scratch(args[1])
    os.dup2(fd, target)
    os.close(fd)
    os.write(target, b"data")
    expect("close(%d)" % target, errno.EIO, lambda: os.close(target))
    os.fstat(target)
    say("fd %d still open after the refused close" % target)
    other = os.dup(target)
    if other == target:
        die("dup returned the filtered descriptor")
    os.close(other)
    say("close(%d) of another descriptor succeeds" % other)
    os.unlink(path)
else:
    die("unknown mode")
